questions.q: What does the phrase 'To hang by a thread' mean?
o: To be in a very precarious situation
questions.x: 'To hang by a thread' means: to be in a very precarious situation.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'The study of insects'
questions.x: 'Entomology' means the study of insects.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Tenacious'.
questions.x: 'Tenacious' means persistent. 'Yielding' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Precarious'.
questions.x: 'Precarious' means uncertain. 'Secure' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To cut corners' mean?
o: To take a shortcut while driving
To do something poorly to save time or money
questions.x: 'To cut corners' means: to do something poorly to save time or money.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A speech made without preparation'
questions.x: 'Extempore' means a speech made without preparation.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
The two brothers / quarrelled among themselves / over the property.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'quarrelled among themselves'. 'Between' is used for two: 'quarrelled between themselves'.

questions.q: Select the antonym of the word 'Vivacious'.
questions.x: 'Vivacious' is the opposite of 'Listless'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Vivacious'.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
He is / the most cleverest / officer in the team.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'the most cleverest'. Double superlative: 'the cleverest'.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
Beside his salary, / he receives / a monthly allowance.
questions.x: The error is in part (a): 'Beside his salary'. 'Besides' (in addition to) is required; 'beside' means next to.

questions.q: According to the passage, many delays are caused by:
o: Incomplete applications sent back and forth
questions.x: Answer: 'Incomplete applications sent back and forth'. The third sentence states this. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: A well-designed form can save more time than a new office. When citizens fill in fewer fields, upload documents once and track their applications online, both the applicant and the official spend less time on correspondence. Many delays are caused not by lack of staff but by incomplete applications sent back and forth. Simplifying the form is often the quickest administrative reform.

questions.q: The author suggests that the quickest administrative reform is often:
questions.x: Answer: 'Simplifying forms'. The last sentence says so. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: A well-designed form can save more time than a new office. When citizens fill in fewer fields, upload documents once and track their applications online, both the applicant and the official spend less time on correspondence. Many delays are caused not by lack of staff but by incomplete applications sent back and forth. Simplifying the form is often the quickest administrative reform.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Non-Cooperation Movement:
1. It included the boycott of government schools, courts and foreign cloth.
2. It was supported by the Khilafat Committee.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Correct answer: Both 1 and 2. Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is correct.
Both are correct.

questions.q: The All India Kisan Sabha was founded in 1936 at:
questions.x: Correct answer: Lucknow. Swami Sahajanand Saraswati was its first president.

questions.q: Gandhi's 'Constructive Programme' included all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.x: Correct answer: Industrialisation through heavy industry. It emphasised village industries, basic education and prohibition.

questions.q: The Paika rebellion of 1817 against the East India Company took place in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Odisha. It was led by Bakshi Jagabandhu.

questions.q: The newspaper/journal 'New India' is associated with:
o: Sisir Kumar Ghosh and Motilal Ghosh
questions.x: 'New India' was started/edited by Annie Besant.

questions.q: The Indian Councils Act, 1892 introduced:
o: The principle of indirect election (nomination on recommendation) to legislative councils
questions.x: Correct answer: The principle of indirect election (nomination on recommendation) to legislative councils. It also allowed discussion of the budget.

questions.q:
Match the slogan with the person who gave it:
Slogan:
A. Do or Die
B. Give me blood, and I will give you freedom
C. Inquilab Zindabad (popularised)
D. Jai Hind (popularised as INA salute)
Associated with:
1. Subhas Chandra Bose
2. Mahatma Gandhi
3. Subhas Chandra Bose's INA
4. Bhagat Singh
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (Do or Die) → 2 (Mahatma Gandhi); B (Give me blood, and I will give you freedom) → 1 (Subhas Chandra Bose); C (Inquilab Zindabad (popularised)) → 4 (Bhagat Singh); D (Jai Hind (popularised as INA salute)) → 3 (Subhas Chandra Bose's INA).
'Inquilab Zindabad' was coined by Maulana Hasrat Mohani and popularised by Bhagat Singh.

questions.q: The Indian National Army was first organised in 1942 by:
questions.x: Correct answer: Captain Mohan Singh. Bose revived and led it from 1943.

questions.q: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of the Shimla Conference (1945) and the Cabinet Mission (1946)?
questions.x: Lord Wavell was Viceroy during the Shimla Conference (1945) and the Cabinet Mission (1946).

questions.q: Choose the correct year for this event: elections to provincial legislatures under the 1935 Act were held.
questions.x: Elections to provincial legislatures under the 1935 Act were held in 1937. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: The Anusandhan National Research Foundation was established under an Act of:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2023. It funds research across disciplines.

questions.q: World Press Freedom Day is observed on:
questions.x: World Press Freedom Day: 3 May.

questions.q:
Consider the following schemes:
1. AMRUT
2. Smart Cities Mission
3. PMAY-Urban
4. Jal Jeevan Mission
How many of the above are primarily urban development schemes?
questions.x:
3 of the 4 listed items satisfy the condition asked.
The first three are urban schemes; Jal Jeevan Mission is for rural households.

questions.q: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to:
questions.x: The South Korean writer was cited for intense poetic prose. Krasznahorkai won in 2025.

questions.q: The military exercise 'Yudh Abhyas' is conducted between India and:
questions.x: 'Yudh Abhyas' is a bilateral exercise between India and United States.

questions.q: 'Rajpath' in New Delhi was renamed in 2022 as:
questions.x: The canopy at India Gate now has a statue of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.

questions.q: Who is the Leader of the Opposition in the 18th Lok Sabha?
questions.x: Correct answer: Rahul Gandhi. Mallikarjun Kharge is LoP in the Rajya Sabha.

questions.q: 'Mission LiFE', launched by India, stands for:
questions.x: Correct answer: Lifestyle for Environment. It promotes mindful consumption and individual climate action.

questions.q: COP30 under the UNFCCC was held in November 2025 in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Belém, Brazil. Belém is at the edge of the Amazon rainforest.

questions.q: In January 2025, the United States announced its withdrawal from:
o: The World Health Organization and the Paris Agreement
questions.x: Executive orders were signed on the first day of the new administration.

questions.q: "Emoluments and allowances of the President, Governors, Judges, CAG and others" is the subject matter of which Schedule of the Constitution?
questions.x: It is the Second Schedule.

questions.q: A 'Vote on Account' enables the government to:
o: Withdraw money from the Consolidated Fund for part of the year pending passage of the budget
questions.x: Correct answer: Withdraw money from the Consolidated Fund for part of the year pending passage of the budget. Article 116; usually for two months, longer in election years.

questions.q: The minimum age to be eligible for election as President of India is:
questions.x: Article 58 prescribes 35 years; the same applies to the Vice-President.

questions.q: The Union Public Service Commission is a constitutional body established under:
questions.x: Correct answer: Article 315. Its members hold office for six years or until 65 years of age.

questions.q: Which Article allows the State to make special provisions for women and children?
questions.x: Article 15(3) is the basis for many protective laws.

questions.q: Dyarchy at the provincial level was introduced by the:
questions.x: The Montagu–Chelmsford reforms divided provincial subjects into transferred and reserved.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): India is called a 'Republic'.
Reason (R): The head of State in India is an elected President and not a hereditary monarch.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: Correct answer: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A. A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. R explains A.

questions.q: Article 54 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment
Elections on the basis of adult suffrage
questions.x: Article 54: Election of the President.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Advocate-General for the State"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 165.

questions.q: The members of a State Public Service Commission are appointed by:
o: The Chief Justice of the High Court
questions.x: Correct answer: The Governor. But they can be removed only by the President (Article 317).

questions.q: Which of the following crops is a kharif crop?
questions.x: Kharif crops are sown with the monsoon (June–July); wheat, mustard and gram are rabi.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): A fall in the repo rate tends to stimulate investment.
Reason (R): A lower repo rate reduces the cost of borrowing for banks, which lowers lending rates.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. R explains A through the transmission mechanism.

questions.q: The Gini coefficient measures:
questions.x: It ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (perfect inequality); the Lorenz curve illustrates it.

questions.q: Nominal GDP of a country is ₹1,30,900 crore and real GDP (at base-year prices) is ₹1,19,000 crore. The GDP deflator is:
questions.x:
GDP deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 = (1,30,900 / 1,19,000) × 100 = 110.
Prices have risen 10% over the base year.

questions.q: The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank Group provides:
o: Concessional loans and grants to the poorest countries
questions.x: IFC lends to the private sector; MIGA provides guarantees; ICSID settles investment disputes.

questions.q: 'India Stack' refers to:
o: A set of open digital public goods such as Aadhaar, UPI and DigiLocker
questions.x: Correct answer: A set of open digital public goods such as Aadhaar, UPI and DigiLocker. It underpins India's digital public infrastructure.

questions.q: The Monetary Policy Committee was constituted — in which year?
questions.x: The Monetary Policy Committee was constituted in 2016.

questions.q: Primary deficit equals:
questions.x: Correct answer: Fiscal deficit minus interest payments. It shows borrowing for current needs excluding past debt servicing.

questions.q: 'Digital India' programme was launched in:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2015. It aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society.

questions.q: 'Narrow money' in India is denoted by:
questions.x: M1 = currency with the public + demand deposits + other deposits with RBI; M3 (broad money) adds time deposits.

questions.q: Under the Written Down Value method, depreciation is charged on:
o: The reducing book value at a fixed rate
questions.x: WDV gives higher depreciation in early years and is accepted under the Income Tax Act.

questions.q: A firm has Cash ₹30,000, Debtors ₹80,000, Inventory ₹75,000, Prepaid expenses ₹7,500, Creditors ₹20,000, Bills payable ₹7,500 and Outstanding expenses ₹5,000. Its current ratio is:
From the following, compute Gross Profit: Opening stock ₹35,000; Purchases ₹2,25,000; Purchase returns ₹2,000; Carriage inwards ₹2,000; Sales ₹2,40,000; Closing stock ₹65,000.
questions.x:
Cost of goods sold = Opening stock + Purchases − Purchase returns + Carriage inwards − Closing stock
= 35,000 + 2,25,000 − 2,000 + 2,000 − 65,000 = ₹1,95,000.
Gross profit = Net sales − COGS = 2,40,000 − 1,95,000 = ₹45,000.
Carriage inwards is a direct expense (Trading A/c).

questions.q: In consignment accounting, the person who sends goods is the:
questions.x: The consignee is the agent who sells on behalf of the consignor for commission.

questions.q: A cheque received from a customer is dishonoured. The entry in the payee's books is:
o: Customer A/c Dr. To Sales A/c
Customer A/c Dr. To Bank A/c
Bad Debts A/c Dr. To Bank A/c
Bank A/c Dr. To Customer A/c
questions.x: Correct answer: Customer A/c Dr. To Bank A/c. The customer again becomes a debtor and the bank balance is reduced.

questions.q: At the break-even point:
questions.x: Correct answer: Total contribution equals fixed cost. No profit, no loss.

questions.q: A computer server is purchased for ₹2,15,000 and ₹3,000 is spent on its installation. Its estimated useful life is 8 years with a residual value of ₹16,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (2,15,000 + 3,000 − 16,000) / 8 = 2,02,000 / 8 = ₹25,250 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 5 : 2. They admit R for a 1/8 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:
A product sells at ₹235 with a variable cost of ₹210 per unit. Fixed costs are ₹1,12,500. The break-even sales (in ₹) are:
questions.x:
P/V ratio = Contribution/Sales = 25/235 = 10.64%.
BEP sales = Fixed cost / P/V ratio = 1,12,500 / 0.1064 = ₹10,57,500.

questions.q: Opening inventory is ₹45,000, closing inventory is ₹40,000 and cost of goods sold for the year is ₹2,12,500. The inventory turnover ratio is:
questions.x:
Average inventory = (45,000 + 40,000) / 2 = ₹42,500.
Inventory turnover = COGS / Average inventory = 2,12,500 / 42,500 = 5 times.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹2,40,000 is depreciated at 25% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 3 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 2,40,000 × (0.75)^3 = ₹1,01,250.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹60,000.)

questions.q: On dissolution of a firm, assets are sold and liabilities paid through the:
questions.x: The realisation account shows profit or loss on realisation.

questions.q: Net profit is transferred to the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Capital account (sole proprietor). In a sole proprietorship, net profit increases capital.

questions.q:
Match the item with its place in final accounts:
Item:
A. Carriage inwards
B. Carriage outwards
C. Goodwill
D. Drawings
Treatment:
1. Profit and loss account
2. Trading account
3. Balance sheet (assets)
4. Deducted from capital
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (Carriage inwards) → 2 (Trading account); B (Carriage outwards) → 1 (Profit and loss account); C (Goodwill) → 3 (Balance sheet (assets)); D (Drawings) → 4 (Deducted from capital).
Direct expenses go to trading, indirect to P&L; assets to the balance sheet; drawings reduce capital.

questions.q: A worker's money wage rises by 10% while consumer prices rise by 6%. The worker's real wage rises by approximately:
questions.x: Approximately, real wage growth ≈ money wage growth − inflation = 10 − 6 = 4% (exactly 1.10/1.06 − 1 ≈ 3.8%).

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a 'trade union' includes:
o: Associations of employers only for charity
questions.x: The definition covers combinations of workers or employers for regulating relations, and federations of two or more unions.

questions.q: The Directorate General of Employment (DGE), which runs the National Career Service, functions under the:
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
questions.x: DGE is under the Ministry of Labour and Employment; training functions (DGT) moved to MSDE in 2015.

questions.q: The Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act was passed by the legislature in the year:
questions.x: The Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act was enacted in 1970.

questions.q: The World Day for Safety and Health at Work, promoted by the ILO, falls on:
questions.x: 28 April promotes prevention of occupational accidents and diseases.

questions.q: When an employee is removed, dismissed, retrenched or resigns, the Code on Wages requires the wages due to be paid within:
questions.x: Section 17(2): wages of an employee who is removed, dismissed, retrenched, resigns or becomes unemployed due to closure must be paid within two working days.

questions.q: A woman employee, with one surviving child, expects her second delivery. Under the maternity benefit law she is entitled to:
o: 26 weeks, of which not more than 8 weeks can precede the expected delivery
questions.x: 26 weeks applies for the first two children; up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected date of delivery.

questions.q: The Madras Labour Union (1918), often called the first modern trade union of India, was founded by:
questions.x: B. P. Wadia formed the union among textile workers of Buckingham and Carnatic Mills; the Madras High Court injunction against it highlighted the need for the Trade Unions Act, 1926.

questions.q: Identify the year of enactment of the Maternity Benefit Act.
questions.x: The Maternity Benefit Act was enacted in 1961.

questions.q: Which case held that the right to form unions under Article 19(1)(c) does not carry with it a fundamental right to collective bargaining or to strike?
o: All India Bank Employees' Association v. National Industrial Tribunal (1962)
Kameshwar Prasad v. State of Bihar (1962)
Sakal Papers v. Union of India (1962)
questions.x: The Constitution Bench held that a guaranteed right to form unions does not imply guaranteed rights to achieve their objectives such as bargaining or striking.

questions.q: Retrenchment compensation under the IR Code is equivalent to how many days' average pay for every completed year of continuous service?
questions.x: Retrenchment compensation is 15 days' average pay for every completed year of service or part exceeding six months.

questions.q: Workers registered on e-Shram are linked to which accidental insurance benefit?
o: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana cover of ₹2 lakh on death or permanent disability
questions.x: Registered workers were given PMSBY accident cover (₹2 lakh for death/permanent total disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability) for the first year.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a strike cannot be started within how many days of giving the strike notice?
questions.x: A strike is prohibited before the expiry of fourteen days from the date of notice.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, women may be employed before 6 a.m. and beyond 7 p.m.:
o: Only if accompanied by a family member
With their consent and subject to conditions on safety, holidays and working hours
Never, as night work for women is banned
questions.x: Section 43 permits women in all establishments for all work, including night shifts with consent and safety safeguards.

questions.q: Douglas McGregor's 'Theory Y' assumes that employees:
o: Can be self-directed and seek responsibility under the right conditions
Dislike work and must be coerced
questions.x: Theory X assumes aversion to work; Theory Y assumes self-motivation and commitment.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, the person who has ultimate control over the affairs of a factory is called the:
questions.x: The occupier is the person with ultimate control over the affairs of the factory; in companies, a director is treated as occupier.

questions.q: Which ministry administers the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme?
questions.x: IGNOAPS is part of NSAP under the Ministry of Rural Development.

questions.q: Form 13 under the EPF Scheme is used for:
o: Transfer of PF account from the previous employer
questions.x: Correct answer: Transfer of PF account from the previous employer. Form 13 facilitates transfer of accumulations to the new account.

questions.q: Gratuity for a non-seasonal employee is calculated at the rate of:
o: 15 days' wages for every completed year of service
questions.x: Fifteen days' wages (based on last drawn wages, with month taken as 26 days) for each completed year.

questions.q: Sickness benefit under the ESI scheme is paid in cash at what rate of wages?
o: 70% for up to 91 days in a year
questions.x: Sickness benefit is 70% of wages for a maximum of 91 days in two consecutive benefit periods.

questions.q: Under the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, a member retires at 58 with pensionable salary of ₹11,000 and pensionable service of 19 years (including any weightage). The monthly member pension is:
questions.x:
Monthly pension = (Pensionable salary × Pensionable service) / 70
= (11,000 × 19) / 70 = ₹2,986.
Pensionable salary is the average of the last 60 months' wages (subject to the ₹15,000 ceiling), and the minimum pension is ₹1,000.

questions.q: If work is not provided within 15 days of application under MGNREGA, the applicant is entitled to:
questions.x: Unemployment allowance is payable by the State if work is not provided within 15 days.

questions.q: The Government's contribution to NPS for Central Government employees was raised from 10% to 14% of basic pay plus DA with effect from:
questions.x: Employees contribute 10% while the Government contributes 14% since 2019.

questions.q: Interest on an employee's own EPF contributions exceeding what amount in a year is taxable (where the employer also contributes) from 2021–22?
questions.x: Interest on employee contributions above ₹2.5 lakh a year (₹5 lakh where there is no employer contribution) is taxable.

questions.q:
Match the scheme with its regulator or implementing agency:
Scheme:
A. NPS
B. EPF
C. ESI
D. PM-JAY
Agency:
1. EPFO
2. PFRDA
3. National Health Authority
4. ESIC
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (NPS) → 2 (PFRDA); B (EPF) → 1 (EPFO); C (ESI) → 4 (ESIC); D (PM-JAY) → 3 (National Health Authority).
Each scheme has a distinct administering body.

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (2019) is a voluntary pension scheme for:
questions.x: It assures ₹3,000 monthly pension after 60 with matching government contribution.

questions.q: 'Direct Benefit Transfer' (DBT) in India relies largely on the 'JAM trinity', which stands for:
o: Jan Dhan accounts, Aadhaar and Mobile numbers
questions.x: JAM enables direct transfer of benefits into beneficiaries' bank accounts, reducing leakages.

questions.q: An employee's monthly basic wages plus DA are ₹11,000. Of the employer's 12% contribution, how much is credited to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) account?
questions.x:
Employer's 12% = ₹1,320. Of this, 8.33% of wages (on a wage ceiling of ₹15,000) goes to EPS: 8.33% × 11,000 = ₹916.
The balance ₹404 (3.67%) goes to the EPF account. The employee's own 12% (₹1,320) goes entirely to EPF.

questions.q: A 'pixel' is:
o: The smallest unit of a digital image
questions.x: Correct answer: The smallest unit of a digital image. Screen resolution is expressed in pixels (e.g., 1920 × 1080).

questions.q: Which of the following is a non-communicable disease?
questions.x: Correct answer: Hypertension. NCDs are not transmitted between people.

questions.q: NaOH (sodium hydroxide) is commonly known as:
questions.x: NaOH (sodium hydroxide) is caustic soda.

questions.q: The image formed by a plane mirror is:
o: Virtual, erect and of the same size
questions.x: Correct answer: Virtual, erect and of the same size. It is also laterally inverted.

questions.q: Which part of the human eye controls the amount of light entering it?
questions.x: Correct answer: Iris (adjusting the pupil). The retina contains rods and cones that sense light.

questions.q: Stars twinkle because of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Atmospheric refraction of starlight. Planets, being closer and appearing as discs, twinkle less.

questions.q: Ctrl + P in most applications opens the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Print dialog. Ctrl + S saves.

questions.q: Which element is used in pencils' 'lead'?
questions.x: Correct answer: Graphite (carbon). Pencil 'lead' is a mixture of graphite and clay.

questions.q: ISRO's headquarters is located in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Bengaluru. Launches take place from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota.

questions.q: The domain '.gov.in' is used by:
questions.x: Correct answer: Government of India websites. '.ac.in' and '.edu.in' are for academic institutions in India.

questions.q: Nuclear power plants generate electricity using:
questions.x: Correct answer: Nuclear fission. The Sun's energy comes from nuclear fusion.

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'Internet Service Provider'?
questions.x: Internet Service Provider is abbreviated as ISP.

questions.q: The average age of 28 trainees in a batch is 10 years. When the instructor's age is also included, the average rises by 1 year. The instructor's age is:
questions.x:
Total of trainees = 28 × 10 = 280.
With instructor: 29 × 11 = 319.
Instructor = 319 − 280 = 39 years.

questions.q: 19 February 1997 was a Wednesday. What day of the week was 19 February 2002?
questions.x:
Each ordinary year shifts the day by 1, and a leap day (29 Feb) crossed in between adds 1 more.
Total days between the dates = 1826 = 260 weeks + 6 odd days.
Wednesday + 6 = Tuesday.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 9 : 5. After 13 years, the ratio will become 49 : 33. What is P's present age?
An inspector drives from town P to town Q at 38 km/h and returns along the same road at 114 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.x:
For equal distances, average speed = 2uv/(u + v) (harmonic mean), not (u + v)/2.
= 2 × 38 × 114 / (38 + 114) = 8664/152 = 57 km/h.

questions.q: Find the volume of a cylindrical water tank of radius 10.5 m and height 23 m. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.x:
V = πr²h = (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 23 = 7969.5 m³.
(Curved surface 2πrh would be 1518 m² — a common mix-up.)

questions.q: There are 64 names in a row of candidates. Imran's name is 34th from the top. What is its position from the bottom?
questions.x: Position from bottom = Total − position from top + 1 = 64 − 34 + 1 = 31.

questions.q: What is the remainder when 655 × 265 × 479 is divided by 11?
A sum of money lent at simple interest amounts to ₹15,600 in 2 years and to ₹22,800 in 6 years. The rate of interest per annum is:
How many arrangements of the letters of 'LABOUR' are there in which the vowels are NOT all together?
questions.x:
Total arrangements = 720 (all letters are distinct).
Vowels together = 24 × 6 = 144.
Not all together = 720 − 144 = 576.

questions.q: In what ratio must coffee seeds costing ₹100 per kg be mixed with coffee seeds costing ₹180 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹137 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (180 − 137) : (137 − 100) = 43 : 37 = 43 : 37.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: The number of claims settled by a regional office increases by 20% in the first year and decreases by 15% in the second year. The net percentage change over the two years is:
A shopkeeper marks his goods 20% above the cost price and allows a discount of 20% on the marked price. His gain or loss per cent is:
questions.x:
Let CP = 100. Marked price = 120.
SP after 20% discount = 120 × 0.8 = 96.
Gain = 96 − 100 = -4 on 100 → 4% loss.
Shortcut: m − d − md/100 = 20 − 20 − 4 = -4%.

questions.q: Find the next term of the series: 4, 9, 20, 43, 90, ?
